text: Absolutely one of the worst experiences in my life! I went there while vacationing with my family tonight. There was a backed up line so my daughter in law and I decided to order in the kiosk. Both of our orders malfunctioned by not providing us with our order numbers. We both went up to the register and told the manager what had happened. He asked y ur s both if the transaction had gone through our bank and we both said yes. I showed him my phone as verification and he said that because my transaction stated that it was pending that it would not clear my bank and he would need to run my card again. I disagreed and called my bank from the car. My bank verified the transaction and that it would hard post overnight if they didn’t refund or cancel the transaction is n their end. All the while my daughter in law stayed inside. They prepared her order, didn’t charge her card again and she got to leave with all of her food! I went back in the restaurant with my daughter in law with me and asked why the gave her food when the same thing happened to me and we are together. The guy said that he didn’t know that we were together and that if I didn’t leave he was going to call the police. I asked him for something showing that he didn’t give me my food and he refused. I asked him who the manager was and he said that he was the manager. I asked him for his bosses name and he refused. When I get back home I will be turning this into fraud with my bank. Never have I ever been treated so poorly!
author: Marilee Daugherity

text: Very annoyed at my experience here, particularly with the young woman named Fatimah, not the right type of job for people like her. To start with we didn’t get a receipt with our food and ended up waiting 50 minutes for our food(it was midnight on a Sunday so was busy but still waited far too long) after waiting about 25 mins we asked Fatimah what the situation was and she just scoffed at us and told us it will be ready when it’s ready, even though we weren’t even sure what our number was so didn’t know if our food had been sent out already. She snapped at my girlfriend to get out the way saying she couldn’t serve people if she was standing in the way(she could). I also watched her call out various numbers and if they hadn’t been collected within about 10 seconds then she would just throw them in the bin which is ridiculous. After about 40 minutes a young lad noticed we had been waiting ages and took it upon himself to write down our order and make it himself, which was great, shame I didn’t catch his name. All in all a bad experience and to any managers reading this I would get rid of Fatimah asap as she comes across as very rude and unprofessional-not the type to be working in a customer based job.
author: Lewis Johnson

text:
absolutely horrendous! Order completely wrong and i spent over £30. McDonalds sort your employees out AS SOON AS POSSIBLE!! This is absolutely shocking. Astounding! Not good enough on any level. Food cold (the cheese bites that i received) and the rest was completely wrong and my bag was packed awfully. Things spread all round the bag. Happy meal open and chips everywhere. Please do not even try to trust an order from this place unless you are ordering a very simple order like Mcflurry (that was also completely mushed and watery)! Mcdonald’s I will say it one last time- SORT. OUT. YOUR. EMPLOYEES!! Stop employing people who clearly don’t know how to arrange an order or are 15 and in their first job. You are losing customers!! No fruit shoot, hot latte and not iced latte, lettuce and it literally says no lettuce multiple places. Ugh the list goes on. Over £30 worth spent and went completely down the drain. You could not careless about your customers just your money.

NEVER EVER EVER EVER. EVER. Again Mcdonald’s. Shameful.
author: DTF youdliketono

text: I came in to order chips and an ice latte on there ordering machines. Once I ordered what I wanted the machine wouldn’t print my receipt I have came across this problem a thew times. Thankfully I remembered my order number and I payed. Once I paid I was standing waiting for 20 minutes keep in mind the place wasn’t busy there was a few people standing waiting on there food I only ordered an iced latte and chips they were all standing and talking and making noises not paying attention at all this is an absolute disgrace! The security and also rude from I came in. They laughed and told us upstairs was closed which it wasn’t. Also to add asked for a sweet curry dip they huffed and threw the dip into the bag. Definitely won’t be rushing back to this place #getitsorted #ofworkersforu
author: Chloe Wilson

text:
Don’t eat here they messed up the order completely.

Ordered the Stormzy meal large

1. The large fries were 45% filled they didn’t even come to the top/edge of the cardboard they came in
2. Oreo McFlurry was missing completely out of the order
3. I ordered a double cheese burger and the pickles when I opened the burger were completely off the bun and to the side of the wrapper and burger was STONE cold and honestly disappointing

I usually never leave a complaint but the service and food was horrendous ordered off of Uber eats so can’t really do much and yeh I understand it’s McDonald’s I’m not expecting A1 service but i at least expect the order to be fulfilled and somewhat Hot. I’d recommend going to a place worth the money and not a big corporation
author: emma Smith

text:
If you can avoid this location as its not worth it. Have consideration for your gut.
They are promoting flavours of the world at the moment so I ordered Polish fries and Australian spicy pineapple burger.
Burger was stone cold. Whoever prepared it just put the ingredients together but its obvious the ingredients are sitting ready for god knows how long.
So basically a sandwich it was.
Not worth 6.50 for what it was.

Polish fries 🍟 arrived as normal fries with a packed of seasoning and a bag that said polish fries.
So from what I gather I was expected to transfer the fries to the bag provided and add the seasoning on from supplied packet.

Unreal.

Read the ingredients list on the packet-never again.All chemicals.

Donegal place is a dive.
author: Dija N.

text:
I normally wouldn't give such a bad review because what can you expect from a McDonald's. But this was such a terrible experience. For starters we didn't get a receipt, then we waited around 45 mins before not hearing our number. When I asked about when I could expect to get my food it seemed lig they didn't even know my order and I had to tell them everything I ordered. They were sold out of about half of the things I wanted and I got a quarter pounder with cheese as compensation. BUT there were no cheese, no sauce og anything. Just bread and patty.
And it wasn't like they were short staffed either. I counted around 10+ people and 3 of them just walked around doing nothing.
Come on guys do better
author: Tobias Torp Klinksgaard

text: They have a big problem when it comes to customised dishes (whenever you adjust the ingredients in the meal). It wasn’t even the first time they couldn’t read properly and make the burger as asked. I customised the McCrispy Deluxe today so that it doesn’t include caramelised onions and relish, and what they’ve given me was just two pieces of bread roll, a chicken fillet and a bit of sauce! No salad or ordinary fresh onions. The last time I also excluded one ingredient from my burger and they couldn’t care less and also just gave me bread, meat, and sauce. Absolute irresponsibility towards customers’ wishes. Hope someone teaches the staff to read. At least they re-made the burger tho.
author: Lera Ivanets

text: Staff are incredibly rude. Staff member spoke to me very aggressively and threatened to bin my food because I didn’t pick it up immediately when I was struggling to get through the massive crowd of drunk people to reach the counter and had tried to signal to him multiple times that I was on the way. Was extremely embarrassing and belittling to be spoken to in such a way. I get McDonalds isn’t a 5 star restaurant but I’ve had so many experiences here of the staff being rude and it’s just unacceptable for them to take out their frustrations on the customers.
author: Elizabeth Louise

text:
I like this McDonald's this is a place where me and my friends have a good time. But I was very disappointed that I ordered a burger for 8£ and in the end I got a "do it yourself" kit. I'm not even talking about the quality of the food but the service was disgusting, i waited for a very long time, they didn't give me a receipt, i paid enough and got a burger that was falling out of a closed box.
I can only praise the toilet, which is free and basically good, but I sympathize with the women in this regard. 2/5 and only because I love this place
author: Oleksandr Shevchenko

text:
We had a great time in Belfast, the 2 days we stayed, the only bad moment we had was when my asked to use the bathroom 1am Friday. We ordered takeout, the bathroom was being used by clients , but when my wife went to use it she was refused by 1 security guard for no reason. She asked why, he said don’t care and don’t have to give you an explanation.
A young Belfast couple couldn’t apologize enough to my wife, they were in complete shock what they had seen,

My wife has a Dublin accent and we believe this was the issue.
author: Thomas Wade

text: Staff in this restaurant extremely rude. Found a piece of paper in my burger, reported to the manager but then a random staff came over and started questioning if I had put it in myself, I asked them to check the CCTV to see if I'd done that but then he started on how I only brought this down when my burger's almost finished. Only after I told him I'm not asking for a new burger did he apologized, unwillingly. Avoid this place unless you want to experience for yourself how they treat their customers. Ridiculous.
author: Victor Wong

text: I tried to order a strawberry lemonade but they gave me the wrong one and it wasnt as cold as it is supposed to be. The fries were old and hard as a brick and didnt have any taste. We didn’t receive the sauce we ordered either. They also didn’t have a product I ordered and they gave us a Mac flurry instead, which was nice. Lastly, the toilet seat was wet because of pee, there was a burger on the ground and the toilet smelled bad. So the service was alright but rest wasn’t.
author: Laura Fenna

text: chips were HARDD AND UNSALTED. also very bad service... they had me waiting 22 minutes on a large fry and a medium coke. i am NOT HAPPY MCDONALDS. as a matter of fact i am appalled. this has disgusted me in numerous ways and the fact that this is labeled as a FAST food restaurant is insane given the fact i could cook a steak with a few chips in the airfryer in the time it took them to make my SMALL MEAL, a snack if you will. appalling mcdonald's, will not be back.
author: Aron Mayfair

text: Building is not fit for purpose - accessible toilets/baby change on ground floor closed, so I had to carry two small children up to the third floor (where the toilets are accessed by a code on the receipt...that staff had taken off me when I collected my food). Toilets weren't clean. Crowds not well managed. Food was cold and I wasn't offered a tray. Tables hadn't been wiped down. Everything felt in need of updating and a deep clean.
author: Stacey McEvoy

text:
My friend and I were at McDonald's and ordered the same thing. We both ordered a 9 piece chicken nugget meal.

The chicken nuggets when bit into were like rubber and were very little flavour of them. My friend had the same problem.
The chips were cold.
The drinks weren't evenly filled as one drink had less than the other.

Sorry to say this McDonald's but we will not be back here I'll take my business somewhere that can cook right.
author: Nicole Scott

text: oh my fod i don’t even know where to start ,literally the worst mcdonald’s i have ever been to in any country ,ive never in my life seen a food place be so so dirty and unsanitary ,spills all over the floors ,food on the floors ,food on the tables literally a foot high in rubbish ,bins overflowing ,20 mins waiting on food whilst there’s only 3 people in the shop,i felt sick from the look of the place i couldn’t even eat my food

text: THIS PLACE IS A JOKE, NOT ONLY IS THE FOOD HORRIBLE EVERY TIME I ENTER THIS PLACE BUT THIS HAS BEEN THE FINAL STRAW. I HAD ORDERED SOME MOZZARELLA BALLS AND A BACON DOUBLE CHEESEBURGER AND TO MY SURPRISE I OPEN MY BURGER TO FIND CLEARLY A STAFF MEMBERS BIT OF SKIN FROM IDK WHERE? THEIR LIP, FINGER? WHO KNOWS BUT BY GOD WAS I DISGUSTED AND THE IDEA OF EVEN GOING BACK TO TRY AN ARGUE FOR A REFUND WAS NOT SOMETHING I WANTED TO DO!

text: I ordered a medium grilled chicken wrap meal with coke zero, i got rubbery cold chicken in the wrap, half filled chips and non fizzy drink, and the staff and manager were very rude. Then when I ordered Apple Pie then the pie was cold soggy and dark brown in color That's terrible food safety and hygiene. I have both the order numbers to prove the incident. I have never seen such bad service from any other McDonald's branch ever.

text: Ordered food at 11pm Sunday with just eat to be delivered to the premier inn, the prefer time kept letting pushed bk everytime it was due, this went on for 2 hrs and because McDonalds had put processing you could cancel, when it arrived at a very unreal time 1.24 am it was dumped outside the hotel minus all the dips, cold rubber chick nugs ice cold chips and ripped bag disgraced had to throw the lot in the bin

text: Do not order just eat from here. The food you order will not be what you get. Waited over an hour for food, it was a 7 minute walk. If it wasn't 12.40 in belfast, id of probably took the chance of going to get the food myself but when I went outside the hotel and seen the group of locals I decided against it. DO NOT USE JUST EAT to get a delivery from the place. I promise you,  you will be disappointed.

text: The only McDonald’s I’ve been to that can’t coordinate a single order between the team. The place was filled with people annoyed their orders were late or half missing. We were missing a single cheese burger from our order which took 20 mins to get. We repeatedly were told ‘I’ve told her she’s going to get it’ during this time, until I spoke to a manager who picked one up in 2 seconds. So badly managed.
author: Liam

text: Honestly, if I could give 0 stars, I would. Our food arrived cold, like it had been sitting there for ages, and the drinks tasted like water — plus they weren’t even filled properly. For the price you’re paying, you’d expect decent portions, but we got about six chips, which is honestly a joke. Really disappointing and definitely not worth the money. I won’t be rushing back anytime soon.
author: Aria Edwards

text:
I never write bad reviews however this time it’s deserved
I just ordered Uber eats my food arrived cold and half the order was missing and there’s no accountability
It was nothing to do with the delivery person that poor guy was so apologetic and so nice
As a Long time customer of McDonald’s, I’m embarrassed by this McDonald’s
I will never return

text: Bought a takeaway meal today (19th October) and asked for milk as my drink. When I got home the milk was dated 17th Oct. That just tells me that there is no one managing the stock maintenance/control. How is anyone meant to have confidence that the food is stored properly and dates checked regularly if they can't even manage milk.

text: Has to be the worst mc Donald’s I’ve been too. Food is cold and burnt. Burger tasted like charcoal. Staff are useless. Saw one dishing the nuggets with his barehands Never felt as uneasy in a place before. Security guard spent more time trying to pick fights with young lads than anytime else. The place is so untidy and disgusting.

text: I’ve placed an order at 00:30am so before closing (01:45am) and it’s 2am and still haven’t received my food. The delivery time keeps changing from 10mins to 20min . No one answers the phone. They don’t even bother to tell they’re closing or they don’t take any orders from now on. They just like to waste people’s time and money.

text: Brutal service. Called today to get two simple burgers. The self service desk never printed my receipt had to then go to the counter to wait to speak to someone to get my number. Which then took 25 mins to collect as they forgot about it. To round it off the burgers were freezing.  Last time I'll ever use the place

text: always missing food for delivery and i waited for two hours with missing sharebox missing burger and 2 missing drinks i don’t even know how they’re operating the whole restaurant, two of us only received a burger and two chips after waiting for 2 hours and nobody takes the call
